name: Fresh Lime Soda
steps: Stir sugar into the measured drinking water until completely dissolved. If any crystals remain, keep stirring before adding the other ingredients.
Add the lemon juice and salt, removing any lemon seeds. Mix well to make an evenly flavoured base and chill it if preparing ahead.
Divide the base evenly between the required glasses, leaving enough room for the soda. Keep the soda chilled and unopened until serving.
Pour soda water slowly down the side of each glass to limit foaming. Stir once gently from the bottom and serve immediately to preserve the fizz.
tips: Add soda at service so it keeps its fizz.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
